quests.modelDraft: Checkout wait times had grown noticeably as the library added more forms of media, each requiring different manual processing steps at the counter. Self-checkout kiosks let visitors scan and check out most items themselves, removing the bottleneck of a single staffed counter processing every different format. The kiosks were sourced from a supplier also used by several nearby libraries, though what matters here is that the shared supplier meant staff could be trained using materials other libraries had already tested and refined. Removing a bottleneck, it turns out, did more for wait times than simply adding a second staffed counter ever could have.
quests.techniqueTip: A powerful essay paragraph follows a deductive progression: Claim → Rationale → Concrete Evidence → Strategic Synthesis. Placing the conclusion prematurely weakens the persuasive payoff.
quests.explanation: The problem and cause together establish exactly what was going wrong and why. The solution directly answers that specific cause, and the reframed relevant detail avoids becoming an irrelevant tangent about the supplier by tying back to training efficiency. The genuine insight closes with a memorable reframing rather than a flat repetition.
